# Worker review API

<!-- Generated by scripts/review_api_docs.py; edit review-api.json and guidance-index.json. -->

This is the model's bounded research API, not the full operator CLI.
The controller supplies its typed schema and remaining budgets each turn.
For scans, plans, finalization and reports use [commands](commands.md).

Every query includes tool, exact prompting review_id (null for change pass), purpose and arguments. Use relative forward-slash source paths. The strict wire shape includes optional path filters as null when unused and an explicit discovery limit (normally 20, maximum 100). Native/defaulted requests may omit those fields. Batch only already-known independent lookups; use their results before dependent reads. Budget ceilings are not spending targets. Only the controller finalizes and admits responses.

| Tool | Arguments | Units | Purpose and limits |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| `source` | path, start_line, end_line | 1 | Read current source at a known path and inclusive line range. At most 400 lines and 64 KiB. Prepared complete-file windows need no confirmation read. Inspect actual returned range and truncation. |
| `base_source` | path, start_line, end_line | 1 | Read the pinned comparison base, including deleted or renamed old files. Same line bounds as source. Only available when the work has a pinned base; current and base coordinates are independent. |
| `outline` | path | 1 | Locate declarations, members and imports in one known current file. AST navigation only. Does not resolve inherited dispatch, follow imports or establish that a named guard applies. |
| `symbol` | name, optional path, optional limit | 1 | Find declaration locations by their reported name. Locator only. Optional path filters the declaration file, not the importing caller. Class.member spelling does not resolve a member; empty or clipped results do not prove absence. |
| `definition` | name, optional path, optional limit | 2 | Locate and read one unambiguous declaration, up to its first 120 lines. Broker convenience built from symbol plus source; not a native CLI subcommand. Ambiguity returns navigation only. source_complete=false leaves the unreturned body unread; follow returned ranges with source. |
| `references` | symbol, optional path, optional path_prefix, optional limit | 1 | Find identifier text uses, scoped to one file or directory. Bounded textual matches, not resolved calls. Choose path OR path_prefix. Limits count occurrences. Read decisive code; previews and empty searches do not prove reachability or absence. |
| `paths` | name, optional limit | 1 | Discover paths using a case-insensitive literal substring. Not a glob. Searches the investigation index; missing runtime or generated files may be outside that index. Read a known source path directly when available. |
| `guidance` | name | 1 | Load one additional trusted review guide by its offered catalog name. Only allowlisted files from the bound skill package. Guidance is instructions, never application evidence or a safety conclusion. Uses the existing round, query, byte and time budgets; no shell or arbitrary file read. |

## Additional guidance

Read the relevant file in manual mode. In worker mode, request
`guidance(name)` using the exact offered name. Load only what changes this
review; never cite a guide as application evidence.

| Name | Read when |
| --- | --- |
| [`sql-query`](categories/sql-query.md) | SQL text, bound parameters, query wrappers or identifiers |
| [`structured-query`](categories/structured-query.md) | NoSQL/BSON operators, executable predicates, search filters or selector objects |
| [`process-code`](categories/process-code.md) | Process launch, shell text, dynamic evaluation or attacker-selected executable |
| [`file-network`](categories/file-network.md) | File containment, archive writes, SSRF, redirects or template-selected files |
| [`authorization`](buckets/authorization.md) | Effective server policy, object ownership, tenancy or delegated authority |
| [`credential-lifecycle`](categories/credential-lifecycle.md) | Issuance, acceptance, recovery, rotation, expiry, consumption or revocation |
| [`mass-assignment`](categories/mass-assignment.md) | Generic body binding, generated CRUD, privileged fields or sensitive object updates |
| [`workflow-state`](categories/workflow-state.md) | Ordering, alternate branches, payment/approval, quotas, repetition or concurrency |
| [`html-output`](html-output-review.md) | Browser interpretation, HTML trust bypass, stored markup, templates or DOM output |
| [`angular-output`](angular-output-review.md) | Angular trust bypasses, pipes, component/template inputs, dialogs or signal bindings |
| [`parser-resource`](categories/parser-resource.md) | Deserialization, XML entities, YAML aliases, archive expansion or parser resource limits |
| [`crypto-configuration`](buckets/crypto-configuration.md) | Signing/encryption, password hashing, randomness, cookie or CORS settings |
| [`native-memory`](buckets/native-memory.md) | C/C++ bounds, lifetime, ownership or native parser state |

A research reply has `action=research`, a nonempty `research` array and
`draft=null`. A final reply has `action=final`, `research=[]` and the complete
draft. Keep the selected operation, progress and remaining questions explicit.
The controller validates protocol and source bindings; it does not certify
the model's security interpretation.
